facts.claim: Budapest's tourist tax (idegenforgalmi adó) is set by each district; Districts I, V, VI, VII and VIII each charge 4% of the room price per guest night, collected by the hotel.

sources.title: District VI notice for hotel operators on the tourist tax (2020)
District I Budavár: adózási ügyek, idegenforgalmi adó

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: districts sets its own tourist tax
it is 4% of the room price per guest night
In Budapest the districts, not the city, set it

facts.claim: District V's and VII's decrees define the tourist-tax base as the price of the guest night less VAT, without compulsory breakfast and other services (District VI's notice says the same); the district websites for I and V describe it as the gross room price.

sources.title: District V: idegenforgalmi adó (says bruttó szállásdíj)
District I: idegenforgalmi adó (says bruttó szállásdíj)

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: define it as the room price less VAT, without compulsory breakfast and other services
The difference is the VAT, so ask the hotel which it uses

facts.claim: Under Act C of 1990 on local taxes, section 31, people under 18 are exempt from the tourist tax; the act lists other exempt groups, including inpatients and people staying for study or for work at a business based in the municipality.

sources.title: Act C of 1990 on local taxes (Htv.), sections 30-34

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: Under-18s are exempt under the national local taxes act
such as inpatients and people staying for study or for work at a business based in the district

facts.claim: Under Act C of 1990, section 33, a municipality's tourist tax is capped at 4% of the base where it uses a percentage (the act's alternative is a fixed per-person, per-night amount, with a base figure of 300 HUF).

sources.title: Act C of 1990 on local taxes (Htv.), section 33

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: with a ceiling of 4% of the room price where it uses a percentage

facts.claim: Our arithmetic: two adults sharing one room at 60,000 HUF a night before VAT and without breakfast, four nights: base 240,000 HUF, tax at 4% is 9,600 HUF (2,400 HUF a night).

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: The base is 240,000 forints and the tax at 4% is 9,600 forints, or 2,400 a night, on top of the room
a night priced at 60,000 forints before VAT adds 2,400 forints of tax

facts.claim: Grand Margaret Island Ensana Health Spa Hotel's FAQ states its prices include VAT and the local city tax, and its site quotes room prices per person per night (from EUR 113 for a Deluxe Double). Margaret Island is, per Wikipedia, directly under city control rather than a district; we found no published island rate.

sources.title: Ensana Grand Margaret Island: FAQ (local taxes)

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: says on its own FAQ that its published prices already include VAT and the local city tax
Ensana quotes its rates from €113 per person per night

facts.claim: Bus 100E runs around the clock between Liszt Ferenc Airport and Deák Ferenc tér (drop-offs Kálvin tér, Astoria, Deák Ferenc tér): every 5-10 minutes by day, 10-15 in the morning and evening, 20-40 at night on average, per the airport.

sources.title: Budapest Airport: public transportation by bus (100E, 200E)
BKK: 24/7 connection between the airport and the city centre

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: It runs around the clock: every 5 to 10 minutes by day, every 10 to 15 minutes in the morning and evening, and every 20 to 40 minutes on average at night, according to the airport
with drop-offs at Kálvin tér, Astoria and Deák Ferenc tér

facts.claim: From 1 April 2026 BKK runs the 100E every 5-6 minutes in the morning and afternoon on Monday, Friday and Sunday, and every 6 minutes on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Saturday.

sources.title: BKK: Április 1-jétől sűrűbben indul a 100E Repülőtéri Expressz (31 March 2026)

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: Since 1 April 2026 BKK, the city's transport authority, has run it every 5 to 6 minutes in the morning and afternoon on the airport's busiest days, Monday, Friday and Sunday, and every 6 minutes on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Saturday

facts.claim: The 100E needs the airport shuttle bus single ticket, 2,500 HUF (up from 2,200 HUF on 1 Oct 2025); holders of a Budapest pass (not the 15-day pass), Pest County Pass or Hungary Pass can buy a 1,000 HUF add-on ticket; payable by bank card on board (Pay&GO) or in the BudapestGO app.

facts.claim: Bus 200E runs day and night between Terminal 2 and Kőbánya-Kispest metro station (transfer to metro M3); regular BKK tickets and passes are required and the airport shuttle ticket is not accepted.

sources.title: BKK: 24/7 connection between the airport and the city centre

The 100E ticket is not accepted on it

facts.claim: BKK single ticket 500 HUF (700 HUF bought on the spot); valid for one ride on one vehicle, transfers only between metro lines; not valid on the 100E. Price from 1 June 2025.

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: BKK's single ticket, 500 forints, covers one ride on one vehicle and allows changes only between metro lines
a single ticket costs 500 forints, or 700 if bought on the spot

facts.claim: BKK 90-minute ticket 850 HUF, phone-only, unlimited transfers within 90 minutes (valid on the 200E and metro; not the 100E).

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: one 90-minute ticket, 850 forints, sold on a phone only

facts.claim: BKK 24-hour Budapest travelcard 2,750 HUF; 72-hour 5,750 HUF.

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: a 24-hour travelcard is 2,750 forints and a 72-hour card is 5,750

facts.claim: The airport's taxi operator is Főtaxi, booked at the stands at Terminals 2A and 2B; Hungarian regulation sets the airport-transfer fare at a base of 2,100 HUF plus 520 HUF/km and 130 HUF/minute, with a fare calculation from the destination address before the trip.

sources.title: Four Seasons Hotel Gresham Palace Budapest

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: An Art Nouveau palace on the Danube, with Danube river-view rooms, a spa and a lobby bar, MÚZSA

facts.claim: Gerlóczy Boutique Hotel: Gerlóczy utca 1, building from 1882, same address as the Parisian-style Gerlóczy Kávéház (breakfast from 7:30, open 7:30-23:00 daily); hotel says main sights are a short walk away.

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: A boutique hotel on Gerlóczy utca in a building from 1882
which serves breakfast from 7:30 every day
the café and restaurant at the address are open every day until 23:00

facts.claim: Anantara New York Palace Budapest: Belle Époque building on Erzsébet krt 9; 185 suites and guestrooms; rooms 30-50 sqm; Anantara Spa and indoor pool; New York Café; short walk from the Madách Theatre and the State Opera House.

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: A Belle Époque building on Erzsébet körút with 185 suites and guestrooms of 30 to 50 sq m, a spa with an indoor pool, and the New York Café inside

facts.claim: Continental Hotel Budapest: 4-star superior on Dohány Street near the Dohány Street Synagogue and Blaha Lujza tér; 270 rooms with Art Deco features; Standard room 18-20 sqm; rooftop wellness, indoor and seasonal outdoor pools.

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: with 270 rooms with Art Deco features, rooftop wellness and indoor and seasonal outdoor pools
the Standard rooms measure 18 to 20 sq m

facts.claim: Hotel Moments Budapest: four-star at Andrássy út 8, 99 rooms in three categories, few steps from the State Opera House and St Stephen's Basilica; 24-hour free coffee, tea and mineral water in the lounge bar; sauna and fitness room; Superior rooms 21-26 sqm, street view.

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: A four-star hotel at Andrássy út 8 with 99 rooms in three categories
the Superior rooms measure 21 to 26 sq m and face the street

facts.claim: Wombat's City Hostel Budapest: building from 1840 on Király utca, former 4-star hotel turned hostel; each room has its own bathroom and air conditioning; WomBAR and WomCAFÉ, free in-house events; Király utca billed as 'the alley of party'; minimum age varies by season and city.

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: In a building from 1840 on Király utca, a former four-star hotel turned hostel
where each room has its own bathroom and air conditioning
the minimum age depends on the season

facts.claim: Carlton Hotel Buda Castle: 4-star on a quiet historic street at the foot of Castle Hill, a few steps from the Chain Bridge; breakfast 07-11; lift access; Economy Single 14 sqm and Economy Double 17 sqm.

articles/where-to-stay-in-budapest.html: a few steps from the Chain Bridge, with breakfast from 7 to 11 and lift access
the Economy rooms are 14 sq m for a single and 17 sq m for a double

facts.claim: Boutique Hotel Victoria: 4-star at Bem rakpart 11 directly on the Danube on the Buda side; 27 Superior rooms of 22-28 sqm facing the Danube; Budget rooms 18 sqm in a separate building, stairway access only, no Danube view.

facts.claim: Hotel Castle Garden: 4-star boutique hotel at Lovas út 41 at the entrance of the Castle District; Széll Kálmán tér a few minutes' walk away; Riso Ristorante & Terrace; Basic rooms are in the basement (-1st floor) overlooking the garden.
